snippet.title: MONOWAVE: Official Co-op Trailer
snippet.description:
Mono could use a little help, too.

Meet Prism, your companion in MONOWAVE’s local two-player co-op. One of you guides Mono, while the other flies around as Prism, passing emotions to nearby creatures and helping with the puzzles. Prism can block incoming projectiles and even become a platform for Mono to jump on.

Explore a world of emotions on your own, or play the full adventure with a friend.

Launching September 16 on Steam and Nintendo Switch.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680440/MONOWAVE/?utm_source=yt&utm_medium=o&utm_campaign=r03

Nintendo Switch (US):
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/monowave-switch/

On PC, co-op supports two controllers or a keyboard and a controller. Steam Remote Play Together is also supported.

#MONOWAVE #CoopGaming #IndieGame
